actual_tools: Biological Sequence & Alignment Viewer 0.1.43 diagnostic attempts recorded in outputs/viewer-operation-evidence.json
execution.implementation: verified local single-residue P01116 G12C copy transformation, plus an unconfirmed shared Viewer diagnostic and a genuine Rosalind task-chooser observation

observations: The reviewed P01116 sequence version 1 protein is 189 residues long and has glycine at residue 12.
The derived copy is also 189 residues and differs only by G12C.
Rosalind Workbench returned its ready task chooser for the recorded case-specific invocation.
The 2026-08-30 Viewer review retained no successful Sequence Viewer operation; failed and unexecuted actions are mapped in outputs/viewer-operation-evidence.json.
interpretation: The retained checks demonstrate a one-residue copy transformation while preserving the standalone source FASTA.
limitations: The protein copy specifies no nucleotide codon, construct, biochemical effect, or clinical interpretation.
rosalind_open did not execute a scientific job and did not create or export the G12C copy.
No Sequence Viewer capability is claimed because the server-created sessions never produced a query-confirmed mounted viewer.

provenance.note: The local script produces and verifies the copy; the separate Rosalind observation preserves the genuine task-chooser response and states that no scientific job ran.

reproduction: From the repository root run python showcases/biological-sequence-viewer/cases/sequence-edit-copy/build_case.py.
Confirm outputs/edit-checks.json reports unchanged_during_edit true, difference_count 1, and length_preserved true.
Treat any later Viewer edit or export as a separate execution.
Inspect outputs/viewer-operation-evidence.json and do not promote failed or unexecuted Viewer actions to capabilities.
